title: File:Cormet de Roselend F.jpg
claims: The Commons file shows the Cormet de Roselend pass in the French Alps, with green alpine slopes, scree and a stream in the foreground.
The file is a landscape photograph of the pass, not a photograph of the TDS race; it contains no runners or event signage.
The author is Philipendula, credited under CC BY 2.5; the original file is 2,560 x 1,920 pixels, 3,625,926 bytes, with a Commons upload date of 2005-10-19.
The file page requires attribution; the route page uses a 960 x 720 Commons thumbnail of 226,970 bytes and credits the author and licence.
